column1: # CHARADES — act it out, no words, no pointing at objects in the room.
# Format: PHRASE<tab>difficulty  (no decoy — that is a RINGER mechanic)
# INTERNATIONAL BY RULE. Every entry has to be actable by someone who has never
# lived in the US or the UK. That means: no baseball, gridiron or cheerleading;
# no Thanksgiving, Halloween or prom; no regional vocabulary (nappy/diaper,
# pram/stroller, queue/line, torch/flashlight); no brand names; no celebrities.
# What is left is the body, the kitchen, work, weather and football — which is
# most of human life, and plays anywhere.
